title: Chicken Breasts Supreme
description: Chicken breasts are browned and coated and baked in a creamy, cheesy sauce with mushrooms for a family-pleasing main dish.
ingredients: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (4.5 ounce) can sliced mushrooms, drained and chopped
0.5 cup processed cheese (such as Velveeta®), diced

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 2-quart casserole dish.

Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and paprika. Melt butter in a large skillet; add chicken and brown well on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to the prepared casserole dish.

Combine mushroom soup, mushrooms, processed cheese, milk, onion, and Worcestershire sauce in a saucepan over medium-low heat until cheese melts, but do not boil. Stir to thoroughly combine, then stir in sour cream until smooth. Pour sauce over chicken; cover with foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until chicken tender and juices run clear, about 45 minutes. Uncover dish, baste with sauce; continue baking 30 minutes more, basting occasionally.
